result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.is_tree()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Check if the graph is a tree. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L4194-L4280){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.is_tree() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A tree is a connected, acyclic, undirected graph. For a graph with *n* nodes to be a tree it: - must be undirected - must be connected (single component) - must have exactly *n - 1* edges - must be acyclic ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `True` if graph is a tree, `False` otherwise. ::: ## Notes {.doc-notes} For directed graphs, use `is_arborescence()` instead. For disconnected forests, use `is_forest()`. ## Examples {.doc-examples} Path graph is a tree: ::: {#3aa996bf .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec tree = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") ) # Returns True tree.is_tree() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` True ``` ::: ::: Graph with cycle is not a tree: ::: {#83b8f156 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} cycle = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "A") ) # Returns False (has cycle) cycle.is_tree() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` False ``` ::: ::: Disconnected graph is not a tree: ::: {#b74a2544 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} disconnected = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") # C is isolated ) # Returns False (not connected) disconnected.is_tree() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` False ``` ::: ::: Star graph is a tree: ::: {#0c1dbab7 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} star = ec.Graph(directed=False) star.add_star_graph(n=5) # Returns True star.is_tree() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` True ``` ::: :::
